rejected_rule.statement: The cause of action arises at the point at which a legally enforceable right is breached.
rejected_rule.supporting_quote: Cause of action is the wrong for the prevention or redress of which an action may be brought, and includes the denial of a right, the refusal to fulfil an obligation, the neglect to perform a duty and the infliction of an affirmative injury.
rejected_rule.statute_citation_verbatim: section 5 of the Civil Procedure Code
